sources.label: Totti's Bondi Private Dining Room — Merivale
Introducing Totti's at The Royal Bondi — Merivale media release

blocks.text: I've talked more friends and visitors through a Totti's reservation than I can count, so let me save you the midnight stress. The surest table is booked online through Merivale the moment your date opens — but if you've left it late, same-day walk-ins are genuinely welcome and cancellations reappear online all the time. Here's exactly how I'd go about it.

items.label: Where
items.value: At the back of The Royal, 283 Bondi Road (corner of Denham Street), Bondi

items.label: The room
items.value: A 185-seat restaurant and courtyard; the woodfired bread is non-negotiable

blocks.text: Reservations run through Merivale's own system on the Totti's venue page — that's the one platform to use. Tables release a set window ahead of time, and that window shifts, so don't trust a fixed number you read on a blog. Open the booking calendar, scroll to the furthest bookable date, and work backwards from there.

items: Jump on the booking page the day your date first opens — lunch and prime dinner slots go fast.
Have your details ready (name, phone, card if requested) so you're not fumbling as tables vanish.
Bend on timing where you can: an early lunch or later dinner beats the 7pm-Saturday scramble, midweek beats the weekend, and a two or three slots in where a table of eight won't.

blocks.text: Keep a tab open on the booking page even after you've missed your ideal night. Totti's spills into that big open courtyard, so when Bondi's weather turns, last-minute cancellations pop back online — I once grabbed a Saturday table on the Thursday before, just by refreshing at the right moment.

blocks.title: Larger groups and special occasions
blocks.text: Big tables, birthdays and set-menu events work differently from a standard booking, and Totti's has a private dining room too. For anything beyond a regular table, call the venue on +61 2 9114 7371 or use the enquiry form on the private dining page rather than the online booking.

No booking? Don't write off a spontaneous visit. A limited number of walk-in tables are held back each day, and your odds are best if you turn up early rather than at peak, keep the group small, and are happy to perch wherever they can seat you — a weekday afternoon is your friend. Failing that, a quick phone call the morning of can turn up a cancellation the website hasn't caught yet.

A bit of history for context: The Royal has anchored this corner of Bondi Road since 1902, and Merivale opened Totti's at the back of the pub in December 2018 with chefs Mike Eggert and Khan Danis. That pedigree is exactly why the room stays busy — and why a little planning pays off. Order the bread.

items.q: How do I book a table at Totti's Bondi?
items.a: Through Merivale's online booking system on the Totti's venue page (merivale.com/venues/tottis), or by phone on +61 2 9114 7371. Booking online is the most reliable route for a standard table.

items.q: How far in advance do bookings open?
items.a: Tables release a set window ahead of your date, and that window can change over time. Rather than trusting a fixed number, open the booking calendar, scroll to the furthest date you can select, and book the moment your date first appears.
Yes — a limited number of same-day walk-in tables are held back. Arrive early rather than at peak, keep the group small, and you'll give yourself the best shot.

At the back of The Royal at 283 Bondi Road, on the corner of Denham Street, a short walk up from the beach. Check the official Merivale page for current opening hours before you go, as they change seasonally.
